_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: ONE POSITION, FOUR LEVELS, ALL FOUR CLEAR - and that sentence is the whole of what this slot is for. OKLO is 44.91 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -0.53%, roughly half a percent below cost with the 54.18 target 20.6% above the bid and the 41.54 stop 7.5% below it. The time stop is the 8/14 close with today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the earnings calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 910 events across 8/10 to 8/14 and OKLO appears in none of them, so the 8/7 print is behind the position rather than inside it and the only watched name reporting in the window is SMCI tomorrow evening. Nothing was due, so nothing was proposed. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL. The order record was queried directly rather than inferred from the balance: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic. So the escalation the 10:46 sync raised stands exactly where it stood - no run in this project published that specification - and it has not compounded this hour. It is carried, not re-argued. THE BOUNCE THE 10:22 HOURLY REFUSED TO CALL A BOTTOM HAS BEEN GIVEN BACK. Breadth is 10 red of 12 against 8 red an hour ago, which puts it back where the open read it, and nine of the twelve names are bid lower than at 10:22. The two marginal greens flipped: QBTS from +0.05% to -1.20%, LEU from +0.07% to -0.71%. The two real greens gave back a third to two-thirds of what they held: SMCI +5.7% to +3.7%, JOBY +4.7% to +1.6%. That vindicates the 10:22 reading that forty minutes of less-bad is not a session of having stopped - and the same honesty requires the next sentence. BOTH OF THAT RUN'S TELLS INVERTED WITHIN THE HOUR. It named SOUN, still falling while its complex bounced, as the cleanest evidence the give-back was unfinished, and UPST, flat while eleven names lifted, as the other. SOUN and UPST are two of the only three names bid HIGHER than at 10:22. The conclusion held and the two pieces of evidence offered for it did not, which is worth writing down because a read that is right for reasons that stop being true is a read that got lucky about its reasoning. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. Against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule the book is one name of four, 8.9% of account value at the bid against a 40% single-name ceiling, and one of two permitted in the nuclear complex.
account.priorNote: THE BOOK IS NO LONGER FLAT, and the board carried an empty book for seven minutes before this sync wrote it - which is the whole reason this run exists. A live read at 10:46 ET returns 2 OKLO at 45.1499 average cost, opened this session. The fill reconciles to the cent: a limit buy of 2 shares at a 45.40 limit, filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 for 90.30, against settled cash that now reads 919.58 where it read 1009.88 at 10:22 - a difference of 90.30 exactly, with nothing unsettled and no deposit pending. WHERE THE ORDER CAME FROM IS RECORDED RATHER THAN EXPLAINED. The broker tags its source as the agentic channel rather than a hand at the app, and no run in this project published an OKLO specification - the day's one specification was the open's 12 JOBY at 8.85, which expired unexecuted at 10:30 against a name that had already run past it. The mandate keeps order placement off for every run here, so an order arriving through that channel is the same pattern the 8/7 retro escalated, and it is escalated again rather than reasoned about. THIS IS THE POSITION SYNC. It mirrors the broker onto the board every ten minutes and decides nothing: it does not propose, size, exit or grade, and an exit specification for anything here is owed by the next hourly or the pre-close, not by this run. NO LEVEL IS BREACHED. At a 45.20 bid the position is +0.11% against a 54.18 target and a 41.54 stop, with a time stop at the 8/14 close. The mid-session deposit the 10:22 hourly escalated stands and nothing here answers it - 900.00 credited between 09:46 and 10:22, still unexplained, and the spread objection that has refused options for three consecutive sessions is untouched by a larger balance. Deployable is 919.58, and against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule this book is one name of four, 8.9% of account value against a 40% single-name ceiling, and one of two permitted in the nuclear complex.
account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.
account.openingNote: THIS IS THE OPENING READ AND THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS DISCHARGED, forced on item 1: buy 12 JOBY at a 8.85 limit, target 10.62, stop 8.14, time stop the 8/14 close, expiring 10:30 ET. Exits were checked before entries and there was nothing to check - a flat book means no target, no stop, no time stop and no option expiry no-fly window was due, and none went unenforced. Two things this run settled that were handed to it by name. FIRST, the straddle Friday's pre-close owed to this slot was pulled: the SMCI 8/14 32 call marks 2.51 against a 2.05 put, a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot, so the market prices a 14.2% move on tomorrow night's print. SMCI is refused on that arithmetic and not on a view - the rulebook stops equity at -8%, and an 8% stop sits entirely inside a 14.2% expected move, so the realistic bad case gaps through the stop rather than filling at it and the exit written before entry would not be the exit taken. That matters beyond the refusal, because SMCI was the ONLY name on this board with a forward catalyst, and once it is gone item 1 cannot be passed anywhere on the list. SECOND, options were priced before any thesis was built, as the 8/5 rule requires, and are refused for a third consecutive session on SPREAD rather than affordability: eight contracts quoted live across JOBY, SOUN and SMR at 3-6 weeks, every one clearing the 0.40 delta floor, several affordable outright, and the tightest of them at 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling. Three different cash balances - 128.90, 126.06 and now 109.88 - have produced the same answer, which is the point at which it stops being about the balance. The tape reversed wholesale over the weekend: breadth is 10 RED of 12 after six consecutive 10-green reads on Friday, and the names that extended hardest into Friday's bell are the ones being unwound hardest now. JOBY is one of two green names and the only green one without a print tomorrow. That is the entry, and it is also exactly what is wrong with it - relative strength on a red tape is a real condition and it is not a catalyst, so item 1 is marked fail and the entry is published forced rather than dressed up as something cleaner.

positions.note: EVERY LEVEL CHECKED AGAINST THE 11:22 BID AND EVERY LEVEL CLEAR, which is the only claim this slot is entitled to make. Target 54.18 needs the 44.91 bid up 20.6%; the 41.54 stop needs it down 7.5%; the position is -0.53% on the bid, 0.48 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost; and the time stop is the 8/14 close with today session one of five. NO-FLY RE-PULLED LIVE RATHER THAN CARRIED: 910 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14 and OKLO is in none of them, so its 8/7 print sits behind this hold rather than inside it, and no option is held for the window to bite on in any case. The position crossed from +0.11% to -0.53% in thirty-six minutes and that is noise, not information - it is 0.24 of a stock whose recent daily range runs several dollars, and a stop 7.5% away is not approached by a quarter. What is worth saying is what has not changed. This is still the name the 10:22 candidate row called the sharpest reversal on the list and refused under checklist item 2, buying day one of a decline, and the tape since has agreed with the refusal rather than with the fill: OKLO is -7.25% against Friday's 48.42 close, having been -6.7% when the sync found the position, and it is the worst name on this board for the third consecutive read. The entry is 45.15 and the board said no within a nickel of it. Provenance is unchanged and unresolved - the order record still shows exactly one order in this account since 8/7, tagged to the agentic channel, with no specification from any run here behind it. That is the retro's to answer. This slot's job is to enforce the levels on a position that exists, whoever opened it, and the levels are clear. Tagged to the nuclear complex, which puts SMR and LEU on the same two-name limit as this position.

entryWatch.setup: JOBY post-earnings continuation - EXPIRED UNEXECUTED, and it has now come back through its own limit
entryWatch.trigger: None, and the trigger is dead in both directions. The 8.85 limit expired at 10:30 ET; JOBY is 8.78 bid now, back BELOW the level, and re-striking a dead specification is a mid-session entry this slot refuses whether the name is above the limit or under it.
entryWatch.why: THE CORRECTION THIS RUN OWES THE RECORD. At 10:22 this board wrote that the forced JOBY entry would be showing a gain - JOBY was 9.05 bid, 2.3% past the 8.85 limit, and the note said so plainly because the forced arm is measured separately precisely so an inconvenient fact changes no rule. One hour later it is 8.78 bid, seven cents BELOW the limit, and the same specification would be showing -0.79%. Both statements were true when written; neither is a rule and neither ever was. What the round trip actually demonstrates is the thing the 10:22 refusal rested on: a name that has run past its level in forty minutes is a name that can come back through it in sixty, which is why chasing it upward at 10:22 would have been the error rather than the missed opportunity it looked like at the time. The refusal is unchanged and its grounds are unchanged - following a name off its level is chasing a green candle, doing it at 11:22 makes it a mid-session entry, and the entry mandate was discharged at the open and does not attach to this slot. Whether an 8.85 limit that never filled counts against the mandate at all is still the retro's call and this run still does not pre-empt it. JOBY gave back 3.0% from its 10:22 bid, the largest give-back on the board bar SMCI, and it is one of only two names still green on the day at +1.6%.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI pre-earnings - REFUSED on its own straddle, and giving back the strength that was the objection
entryWatch.trigger: None. The 8/14 32-strike straddle prices a 14.2% move on the 8/11 print and an 8% stop cannot survive it. Re-confirmed live on the calendar at 11:22: 8/11, pm, verified, estimate 0.88 - the only watched name printing inside the 8/10-8/14 window.
entryWatch.why: Unchanged in its arithmetic and slightly changed in its tape. SMCI is 32.28 bid, +3.7%, down from +5.7% at 10:22, so it has given back a third of the strength that made item 5 loud - and that neither weakens nor strengthens the refusal, because the refusal was never about the direction. The 8/14 32 call marked 2.51 against a 2.05 put for a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot: a 14.2% implied move on tomorrow night's report, against a rulebook stop of 8%. An 8% stop sitting entirely inside a 14.2% expected move is an exit the event is priced to jump rather than fill, which is the sense in which item 3 is a gate and not a formality. Any 3-6 week option necessarily spans the print and is forbidden outright, so the option route was never reachable either. The print is now roughly thirty hours out and this board holds nothing in it.

entryWatch.setup: The speculative complex - the bounce is over and the give-back has resumed
entryWatch.trigger: No level, and this read moves further from one rather than closer. Breadth went 10 red at the open to 8 red at 10:22 and back to 10 red now, with nine of twelve names bid below their 10:22 quotes. A bounce that lasted forty minutes and was fully surrendered in the next sixty is the shape item 2 refuses, not the pullback it buys.
entryWatch.why: THE 10:22 CONCLUSION HELD AND ITS EVIDENCE DID NOT, and both halves are recorded. That run said the improvement from 10 red to 8 red was a bounce off the opening low rather than a bottom, and it was right: the two marginal greens have flipped back - QBTS +0.05% to -1.20%, LEU +0.07% to -0.71% - and the two real ones have surrendered most of their gains, SMCI +5.7% to +3.7% and JOBY +4.7% to +1.6%. But the two specific tells it offered have both inverted. SOUN, named as the cleanest evidence the give-back was unfinished because it kept falling while its complex bounced, is now one of only three names bid HIGHER than at 10:22, at 7.53 from 7.44. UPST, named as the other tell for going nowhere while eleven names lifted, is the second of those three at 30.66 from 30.37. IONQ is the third. So the board that fell is not the board that was falling an hour ago, and a correct call whose stated reasons stopped being true within the hour is worth marking as such rather than banking as a good read. The deterioration this hour is elsewhere and is worst in the same complex the account is now long: MARA -2.1% to -4.5%, SMR -3.4% to -4.3%, OKLO -6.7% to -7.3%. Nothing here is buyable and nothing here is proposed - this slot opens nothing, and the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design.

20.51 bid, -1.2%, having been +0.05% an hour ago and -2.5% at the open. A name that has been red, then flat, then red inside two hours is describing volatility rather than building a base, and it missed on 8/6 at -0.13 against -0.10.

43.46 bid, -2.2%, the third of the three names firmer than at 10:22 and the best of the quantum group on the hour. One share is 4.3% of the account, which is under the 10% floor at which a full +20% winner adds less than one percent to the day - so it is now too small to matter rather than too big to afford, and the older objection still stands anyway: an 8% stop is 3.48 of room in a name mid-unwind from a +10.6% Friday.

9.64 bid, -4.5%, deteriorating hard from the -2.1% it had recovered to at 10:22 and now the second-worst name on the board. It was the weakest name on Friday's green tape and it is still making the lowest lows of this group across four sessions. The half-bounce it had put in is entirely gone.

9.40 bid, -4.3%, and it has lost the 9.505 8/5 high again after reclaiming it intraday at 10:22 - which is exactly the distinction that row drew, between reclaiming a level for forty minutes and holding it for a session. Third name in the nuclear complex and the account already holds one of the two slots that complex allows. This is also the name this account lost 14.0% in on 8/6.

7.53 bid, -6.1%, and it is now one of only three names bid HIGHER than at 10:22, up from 7.44. An hour ago it was the single name falling while its complex bounced, and this board called that the cleanest evidence the give-back was unfinished; it has since done the opposite of what that evidence predicted while the conclusion drawn from it turned out right anyway. Still the second-worst name on the day behind OKLO, and it led Friday at +13.4%.

HELD - see the exit board for its levels. 44.91 bid, -7.25%, the worst name on this list for a third consecutive read and lower than at both the open and 10:22. The account is long 2 shares at 45.1499 from a 10:39:30 fill, which is within a nickel of the bid this board was quoting at 10:22 while refusing the name under item 2 for being day one of a decline. Everything that row said stands and the tape has agreed with the refusal rather than with the fill.
